title: Algorithmic Harms in Child Welfare: Uncertainties in Practice, Organization, and Street-level Decision-Making
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative ethnographic study examining the sociotechnical impacts and harms of algorithmic decision-making in the child welfare system. While it discusses fairness and ethical use of technology as it pertains to professional practice and administrative processes, it does not involve benchmarking or evaluating religion, morality, or ethics within LLMs or NLP systems.
